6.366 rsInvalidRelationshipDataSetUsedMoreThanOnce
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidRelationshipDataSetUsedMoreThanOnce is a critical error that will occur when a DataSet is
referenced by two DataRegions that both have a Relationship specified and are within the same top
level DataRegion.
